verdict.rationale: The first-party docs give one concrete usage limit: each source can hold up to 500,000 words or 200MB. They also acknowledge that AI generation limits exist and that paid subscriptions are a tier, but nothing in the pack explains plan prices or what each tier includes. missing for 10: plan pricing details, tier-by-tier comparison of usage/generation limits, quantified AI generation quotas, independent corroboration of pricing clarity.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can understand plan pricing and usage limits before committing

citations.quote: Each source can contain up to 500,000 words or up to 200MB for uploaded files.
When you are out of AI limits, you can now delay generations for later.
Owners of public notebooks with paid subscriptions can view usage analytics in the analytics tab.
